description.value: Optimized VBM preprocessing with study-specific template and tissue priors, segmentation, registration, re-segmentation, non-brain voxel removal, Jacobian modulation, and smoothing.

spans.text: The optimized VBM consists of two steps: creation of study-specific whole brain template and GM, WM and CSF priors; and data segmentation, registration to and re-segmentation in standard space, using the customized template and tissue priors. The VBM2 toolbox used a hidden Markov random field method to remove maximum of non-brain voxels from the data and minimize the noise level in resulting images. Furthermore, a Jacobian determinant was introduced to modulate the resulting GM images so that the voxel's values indicate the absolute volume of the local GM.
VBM2 toolbox ( http://dbm.neuro.uni-jena.de/vbm ), one extension of the SPM2 software package
